title: Castelcicala to Naples, two undated letters in a second code (ASNa Esteri 2337, DECODE R9586, R9588)

steps.what: DECODE API metadata for R9532-R9591 and page images (with R9586, R9588) fetched with the session cookie.

All 27 records of busta 2337 transcribed from full-resolution crops by two sub-agents; R9586 and R9588 found to be in a different code (values about 100-1100) with sparse pencil glosses; set aside, not attacked.

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from castelcicala1816, which had included R9586 and R9588, two Castelcicala letters in a different code (values about 100-1100), with the despatches in the Segreteria di Stato code. This profile keeps R9586 and R9588 only.

outcome.method_basis: The two letters were transcribed and found to be in a second code with sparse pencil glosses; neither the glosses nor any key has been aligned with them yet.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No group of cipher/R9586.txt or cipher/R9588.txt is claimed as read.
outcome.notes: In progress: transcribed 21 Sept 2026, not attacked. The pencil glosses are a possible crib. Split 14 Oct 2026 from castelcicala1816.

gaps.detail: faint pencil syllabic glosses noted but not aligned; no key
